title: AIS Transponder Closest-Approach Alerts
dataSources: Battery telemetry (`marine:battery`), AIS traffic (`marine:ais`), shore power (`marina:power`), tide forecasts (`tide:table`), export syncs (`marine:export`).
app: Boating and marine telemetry — Victron BMV battery exports, AIS transponder logs, shore-power meter readings, and NOAA tide tables — streamed to Splunk HEC via NMEA exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=marine:ais zone=* closest_approach_nm=*
| stats avg(closest_approach_nm) as avg_closest_approach_nm, count as events by zone
| sort  avg_closest_approach_nm
description: Shows average closest-approach nautical miles by navigation zone for AIS traffic safety.
value: Average closest-approach nautical miles by navigation zone helps compare AIS traffic safety across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `closest_approach_nm` on `marine:ais` events and normalize `zone` so Splunk can summarize performance by navigation zone.
visualization: Bar chart of average closest-approach nautical miles by navigation zone.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the average closest-approach nautical miles for each navigation zone so you can see what works best for AIS traffic safety.
